meta.title: Free resources 1: design, media and AI
meta.subtitle: Design tools, colour and type, assets, media, local AI and AI builders
meta.notes: Hand-picked, lesser-known tools. Mainstream libraries, frameworks and courses are intentionally excluded. Pricing reflects the plan that matters to builders: free, open-source or a genuinely usable free tier. Always check each tool's current terms.

resources.name: Lunacy
resources.description: Free offline UI design app that opens Sketch files and ships with built-in icons and illustrations.
resources.why: A full interface design tool with no subscription, useful when you need to open a .sketch file on Windows or Linux.

resources.name: Quant-UX
resources.description: Prototyping and usability-testing tool that records where testers click and scroll.
resources.why: Lets you test a prototype with real people and see heatmaps without paying for a research suite.

resources.name: Pencil Project
resources.description: Open-source GUI prototyping app with stencil collections for desktop, web and mobile.
resources.why: A quick way to sketch wireframes offline with ready-made shapes.

resources.name: Wireframe.cc
resources.description: Deliberately minimal wireframing tool that keeps you from over-designing.
resources.why: Forces layout thinking first; you cannot get distracted by colour or fonts.

resources.name: tldraw
resources.description: Infinite-canvas whiteboard whose SDK is also open source.
resources.why: Fast for flow sketches and as a base if you want to embed a canvas in your own app.

resources.name: Shots
resources.description: Drops screenshots into clean device frames and gradient backgrounds in the browser.
resources.why: Produces polished product mockups for launches and portfolios in under a minute.

resources.name: Rive
resources.description: Real-time interactive animation tool with a small runtime for web and mobile.
resources.why: State-driven animations that respond to input and weigh far less than video or GIF.

resources.name: Photopea
resources.description: Browser image editor that reads and writes PSD, XCF, Sketch and Figma files.
resources.why: Handles a surprising number of formats with no install; ads are the only cost.

resources.name: Graphite
resources.description: Open-source vector and raster editor with a node-based procedural workflow.
resources.why: Non-destructive, procedural graphics editing built from nodes instead of layers.

resources.name: Boxy SVG
resources.description: Focused SVG editor with precise path and boolean tools.
resources.why: Edits real SVG, so what you export is clean markup you can ship.

resources.name: SVG-Edit
resources.description: Lightweight in-browser SVG editor you can also embed in your own page.
resources.why: Good for quick fixes and for adding an SVG editor to a project.

resources.name: Vectr
resources.description: Free vector editor with live collaboration and shareable links.
resources.why: Simple enough for beginners while still producing SVG output.

resources.name: Akira
resources.description: Native Linux vector design app built for UI and UX work.
resources.why: A GTK-native option for Linux designers who do not want a web tool.

resources.name: Pixso
resources.description: Collaborative UI design tool with prototyping and a developer handoff mode.
resources.why: A generous free plan that covers team design and handoff.

resources.name: Theatre.js
resources.description: Animation toolkit with a visual timeline editor for Three.js and the DOM.
resources.why: Gives motion work a proper timeline instead of hand-tuned numbers in code.

resources.name: Cables
resources.description: Node-based visual programming for real-time WebGL graphics that exports to the web.
resources.why: Build shaders and 3D scenes visually and publish them as a normal web page.

resources.name: Realtime Colors
resources.description: Shows your colour palette and font pairing on a live mock site as you edit.
resources.why: You judge a palette on a real layout instead of a swatch row.

resources.name: Huemint
resources.description: Machine-learning palette generator that previews colours on brand, website and illustration mockups.
resources.why: Palettes arrive already applied to real layouts, which makes picking faster.

resources.name: Khroma
resources.description: Learns your colour preferences and generates endless palettes you may like.
resources.why: Good when you know what you like but cannot name it.

resources.name: Happy Hues
resources.description: Hand-built palettes shown inside a small real page so you see colour roles in context.
resources.why: Teaches which colour goes on background, heading, button and paragraph.

resources.name: Colormind
resources.description: Palette generator with a free API; can extract colours that suit a website or a photo.
resources.why: Useful when you want palettes generated from code.

resources.name: Leonardo
resources.description: Adobe's contrast-based colour generator that builds scales around target contrast ratios.
resources.why: Guarantees accessible contrast between steps instead of hoping.

resources.name: Who Can Use
resources.description: Shows how a colour pair is seen by people with different visual impairments.
resources.why: Moves contrast checking from a pass/fail ratio to real human conditions.

resources.name: OKLCH Picker
resources.description: Colour picker for the perceptually uniform OKLCH space with CSS output.
resources.why: Lets you build palettes where equal steps actually look equal.

resources.name: Fontjoy
resources.description: Generates font pairings and lets you lock one font while re-rolling the other.
resources.why: A quick way to find heading and body pairs without trial and error.

resources.name: Fontsource
resources.description: Self-hosted open-source fonts packaged for npm.
resources.why: Ship fonts from your own domain, no third-party request.

resources.name: Fontshare
resources.description: Free quality typefaces from the Indian Type Foundry, licensed for commercial use.
resources.why: Professional alternatives to the usual few web fonts.

resources.name: Velvetyne
resources.description: Libre type foundry with experimental, characterful open-licence fonts.
resources.why: Distinctive display fonts you will not see on every other site.

resources.name: Wakamai Fondue
resources.description: Drop in a font file and see every feature, axis and glyph it supports.
resources.why: Tells you exactly which OpenType features and variable axes you can use.

resources.name: Axis-Praxis
resources.description: Playground for variable fonts with sliders for every axis.
resources.why: Understand what a variable font can do before you commit to it.

resources.name: Utopia
resources.description: Calculator for fluid type and spacing scales that interpolate between two screen sizes.
resources.why: Replaces dozens of breakpoints with a few clamp() values.

resources.name: Type Scale
resources.description: Visual type-scale generator using musical-interval ratios.
resources.why: Pick a ratio, preview real text, copy CSS.

resources.name: Tints.dev
resources.description: Generates a full 50-950 shade scale from one colour and exports Tailwind or CSS variables.
resources.why: Turn a single brand colour into a consistent scale in seconds.

resources.name: Grabient
resources.description: Large gallery of gradients with CSS output and an editor.
resources.why: Fast way to find a tasteful gradient and copy the code.

resources.name: uiGradients
resources.description: Curated list of two-colour gradients with one-click CSS.
resources.why: A tidy shortlist that avoids the muddy gradients most generators produce.

resources.name: Poolors
resources.description: Palette explorer that lets you lock colours and shuffle the rest.
resources.why: Quick palette exploration with no sign-up.

resources.name: ColorSpace
resources.description: Builds palettes and gradients from a single starting colour.
resources.why: Gives several harmonious directions from one seed colour.

resources.name: Open Peeps
resources.description: Hand-drawn illustration library of mix-and-match people, CC0.
resources.why: Compose your own characters for landing pages with no attribution.

resources.name: Humaaans
resources.description: Mix-and-match illustrations of people with free source files.
resources.why: Quick on-brand characters with editable layers.

resources.name: Open Doodles
resources.description: Free sketchy illustrations released into the public domain.
resources.why: A loose hand-drawn style that avoids the corporate-flat look.

resources.name: ManyPixels Gallery
resources.description: Free illustration gallery with recolourable SVGs.
resources.why: Match illustrations to your palette before download.

resources.name: Storyset
resources.description: Customisable, animatable illustrations; free with attribution.
resources.why: Pick a style, change colours and download animated variants.

resources.name: DrawKit
resources.description: Free and premium vector illustration packs.
resources.why: Consistent illustration sets rather than one-off images.

resources.name: Iconoir
resources.description: Open-source icon library with 1,600+ icons in a consistent line style.
resources.why: Clean, MIT-licensed icons with packages for most frameworks.

resources.name: Pixelarticons
resources.description: Pixel-perfect icon set drawn on a 24px grid.
resources.why: Retro 8-bit look that still scales cleanly.

resources.name: Phosphor Icons
resources.description: Flexible icon family with six weights per icon.
resources.why: Switch weight to match your type without changing the icon set.

resources.name: Teenyicons
resources.description: Tiny 15px icon set tuned for small sizes.
resources.why: Stays crisp where 24px icons turn to mush.

resources.name: Radix Icons
resources.description: Crisp 15x15 icon set from the Radix team.
resources.why: Matches dense interfaces and dashboards.

resources.name: Iconify
resources.description: Unified search and API across 200k+ open-source icons from many sets.
resources.why: One search box and one API instead of juggling icon packages.

resources.name: SVG Repo
resources.description: Huge collection of free SVG vectors with licence shown per item.
resources.why: Find obscure icons and shapes that major sets do not have.

resources.name: game-icons.net
resources.description: Thousands of CC-BY game-style icons you can recolour.
resources.why: Unusual, expressive icons for games and playful interfaces.

resources.name: Hero Patterns
resources.description: SVG background patterns with adjustable colour and opacity.
resources.why: Add subtle texture as a tiny inline SVG, not an image file.

resources.name: Pattern Monster
resources.description: Customisable SVG pattern generator with live preview.
resources.why: Tweak size, colour and spacing and export clean SVG.

resources.name: Haikei
resources.description: Generates SVG waves, blobs, layered shapes and gradients for backgrounds.
resources.why: Produces unique SVG backgrounds instead of stock images.

resources.name: Blobmaker
resources.description: Creates random organic blob SVG shapes.
resources.why: Soft decorative shapes for hero sections.

resources.name: Shape Divider
resources.description: Generates SVG section dividers with copy-paste CSS.
resources.why: Break up sections with waves and curves without images.

resources.name: Fffuel
resources.description: A set of small generators for gradients, patterns, blobs and shapes.
resources.why: One bookmark for many tiny design generators.

resources.name: Transparent Textures
resources.description: Library of subtle repeating textures with transparent backgrounds.
resources.why: Add paper and fabric feel over any colour.

resources.name: Poly Pizza
resources.description: Free low-poly 3D models, mostly CC0 or CC-BY.
resources.why: Drop-in 3D assets for web scenes and prototypes.

resources.name: Quaternius
resources.description: Free CC0 3D model packs: characters, props, nature, UI.
resources.why: Large consistent packs rather than single models.

resources.name: Kenney
resources.description: Thousands of CC0 game assets: sprites, UI, audio and 3D.
resources.why: Public-domain packs you can use commercially with no credit.

resources.name: Poly Haven
resources.description: CC0 HDRIs, PBR textures and 3D models.
resources.why: Real-world lighting and materials for 3D web scenes.

resources.name: ambientCG
resources.description: CC0 PBR materials, HDRIs and decals.
resources.why: High-quality tileable textures with every map included.

resources.name: 3dicons
resources.description: Free 3D icon set in PNG, Blender and Figma formats, CC0.
resources.why: Adds depth to feature sections without custom 3D work.

resources.name: Mixkit
resources.description: Free stock video clips, music and sound effects under a simple licence.
resources.why: Background video and sound without attribution hassle.

resources.name: Coverr
resources.description: Free stock video for website backgrounds.
resources.why: Short looping clips designed for hero sections.

resources.name: Openverse
resources.description: Search engine for openly licensed images and audio.
resources.why: Find reusable media with the licence shown up front.

resources.name: Freesound
resources.description: Collaborative database of Creative Commons sound samples.
resources.why: UI sounds and ambience with clear licences and an API.

resources.name: Burst
resources.description: Free stock photos aimed at commerce and lifestyle.
resources.why: Product-style photography without Unsplash's popularity.

resources.name: StockSnap
resources.description: CC0 stock photos with fast search.
resources.why: Public-domain photos you can use anywhere.

resources.name: Gratisography
resources.description: Quirky, characterful free photos by one photographer.
resources.why: Images that do not look like stock.

resources.name: Kaboompics
resources.description: Free photos with extractable colour palettes.
resources.why: Pick a photo and get matching palette codes.

resources.name: Squoosh
resources.description: In-browser image compressor with side-by-side quality comparison for modern formats.
resources.why: See exactly how much quality you lose converting to WebP or AVIF.

resources.name: SVGOMG
resources.description: GUI for SVGO that optimises SVG files with live preview.
resources.why: Often halves SVG size without visible change.

resources.name: Caesium
resources.description: Batch image compressor for JPEG, PNG, WebP and GIF.
resources.why: Compress a whole folder offline with a quality slider.

resources.name: VTracer
resources.description: Converts raster images to colour SVG vectors.
resources.why: Handles full-colour images, not just black-and-white tracing.

resources.name: background-removal-js
resources.description: Removes image backgrounds entirely in the browser, no upload needed.
resources.why: Private background removal you can embed in your own app.

resources.name: rembg
resources.description: Command-line and API tool that removes image backgrounds.
resources.why: Script background removal over hundreds of images.

resources.name: Upscayl
resources.description: Free AI image upscaler that runs locally on your GPU.
resources.why: Enlarge images on your own machine with no upload.

resources.name: IOPaint
resources.description: Local image inpainting tool for removing objects from photos.
resources.why: Erase unwanted items without sending photos to a service.

resources.name: ffmpeg.wasm
resources.description: FFmpeg compiled to WebAssembly so video and audio convert in the browser.
resources.why: Build converters with zero server cost.

resources.name: Gifski
resources.description: High-quality video to GIF converter.
resources.why: Far better colours and size than typical GIF makers.

resources.name: ScreenToGif
resources.description: Records screen, webcam or sketchboard and edits frames into a GIF.
resources.why: Edit individual frames before exporting.

resources.name: Cap
resources.description: Open-source screen recorder with instant sharing links, positioned as a Loom alternative.
resources.why: Record and share walkthroughs without a subscription.

resources.name: ShareX
resources.description: Windows screen capture, recording and upload tool with automation.
resources.why: Capture, annotate and upload in one hotkey.

resources.name: Shutter Encoder
resources.description: Friendly FFmpeg front-end for converting and compressing video and audio.
resources.why: FFmpeg power without writing commands.

resources.name: Subtitle Edit
resources.description: Subtitle editor with auto-sync and speech-to-text.
resources.why: Fix, translate and time subtitles properly.

resources.name: Kdenlive
resources.description: Full non-linear video editor with multi-track timeline.
resources.why: A real editor with no watermarks or limits.

resources.name: Shotcut
resources.description: Cross-platform video editor with wide format support.
resources.why: Lightweight editor that handles odd formats.

resources.name: Ocenaudio
resources.description: Fast, simple audio editor with real-time effect previews.
resources.why: Quick cleanup edits without learning a DAW.

resources.name: Tesseract.js
resources.description: Runs OCR in the browser or Node with 100+ languages.
resources.why: Extract text from images without any server.

resources.name: FLUX.1 schnell
resources.description: Fast open image-generation model under the Apache 2.0 licence.
resources.why: Commercially usable image generation in a few steps.

resources.name: Qwen2.5-Coder
resources.description: Open code-focused language model family from Alibaba.
resources.why: Strong open coding model you can run locally or via free hosts.

resources.name: Qwen2.5-VL
resources.description: Open vision-language model that reads screenshots, charts and documents.
resources.why: Useful for turning a UI screenshot into a written spec.

resources.name: DeepSeek-R1
resources.description: Open-weights reasoning model with MIT-licensed weights and distilled smaller versions.
resources.why: Reasoning model whose distilled variants run on consumer hardware.

resources.name: Phi-3 mini
resources.description: Small, capable language model from Microsoft under MIT licence.
resources.why: Runs on a laptop or phone while staying useful.

resources.name: SmolLM2
resources.description: Compact language models from Hugging Face in 135M to 1.7B sizes.
resources.why: Tiny models that run in the browser or on low-end devices.

resources.name: SmolVLM
resources.description: Small open vision-language model.
resources.why: Image understanding on modest hardware.

resources.name: moondream2
resources.description: Tiny vision-language model that answers questions about images.
resources.why: Runs locally for image captioning and visual Q&A.

resources.name: Whisper large-v3
resources.description: Open speech-recognition model supporting about 100 languages.
resources.why: High-quality transcription you can run yourself.

resources.name: Kokoro-82M
resources.description: Very small, Apache-licensed text-to-speech model.
resources.why: Natural-sounding speech from a model small enough to run on CPU.

resources.name: bge-m3
resources.description: Multilingual embedding model supporting long inputs and hybrid retrieval.
resources.why: A strong free embedding model for search and RAG.

resources.name: all-MiniLM-L6-v2
resources.description: Small, fast sentence-embedding model.
resources.why: Cheap semantic search that runs on CPU or in the browser.

resources.name: Transformers.js
resources.description: Runs Hugging Face models directly in the browser with WebAssembly and WebGPU.
resources.why: AI features with no backend and no API bill.

resources.name: WebLLM
resources.description: Runs large language models in the browser using WebGPU.
resources.why: Fully private chat inside a web page.

resources.name: HuggingChat
resources.description: Free chat interface that lets you switch between open models.
resources.why: Compare open models without installing anything.

resources.name: LMArena
resources.description: Blind side-by-side model comparison with a crowd-sourced leaderboard.
resources.why: Judge models on your own prompts and see real rankings.

resources.name: Pollinations
resources.description: Free image and text generation endpoints that need no API key.
resources.why: Prototype AI features with a plain URL request.

resources.name: Groq Console
resources.description: Very fast inference for open models with a free tier.
resources.why: Near-instant responses for prototypes.

resources.name: Cerebras Inference
resources.description: Fast hosted inference of open models with a free tier.
resources.why: Another quick, free way to call open models.

resources.name: Google AI Studio
resources.description: Prompt playground and API keys with a free usage tier for Gemini models.
resources.why: Generous free API for prototypes and testing.

resources.name: GitHub Models
resources.description: Playground and API for many hosted models using your GitHub account.
resources.why: Try and compare models with no extra signup.

resources.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
resources.description: Run open models at the edge with a free daily allowance.
resources.why: AI inference next to your Workers with no GPU to manage.

resources.name: NVIDIA Build
resources.description: Hosted playground and API for many models with free credits.
resources.why: Test large open models without hardware.

resources.name: OpenRouter free models
resources.description: One API in front of many models; filter to those that cost nothing.
resources.why: A single key that reaches many free models.

resources.name: Kaggle Notebooks
resources.description: Free notebooks with GPU time each week.
resources.why: Run and fine-tune models without owning a GPU.

resources.name: Lightning AI Studios
resources.description: Cloud dev environments with free monthly GPU credits.
resources.why: A persistent cloud workstation for ML experiments.

resources.name: Unsloth
resources.description: Fine-tune open models faster and with less memory, with free notebooks.
resources.why: Fine-tuning on a free-tier GPU becomes realistic.

resources.name: llama.cpp
resources.description: C/C++ inference engine that runs quantised LLMs on CPUs and GPUs.
resources.why: The engine under many local-AI tools.

resources.name: llamafile
resources.description: Packs a model and runtime into one executable file.
resources.why: Share a working local LLM as a single file.

resources.name: Open WebUI
resources.description: Self-hosted chat interface for local and remote models.
resources.why: A polished UI for whatever model runner you use.

resources.name: Jan
resources.description: Offline desktop app that runs open models locally.
resources.why: Privacy-first local chat with a simple interface.

resources.name: GPT4All
resources.description: Desktop app for running models locally, including document chat.
resources.why: Runs on ordinary hardware without a GPU.

resources.name: Msty
resources.description: Polished desktop front-end for local and online models.
resources.why: Compare models side by side in one window.

resources.name: KoboldCpp
resources.description: Single-file local LLM runner with a built-in web UI.
resources.why: Easy download-and-run local inference.

resources.name: ComfyUI
resources.description: Node-based interface for building image and video generation pipelines.
resources.why: Full control over diffusion workflows.

resources.name: Fooocus
resources.description: Simplified Stable Diffusion image generator with minimal settings.
resources.why: Good images without prompt-engineering gymnastics.

resources.name: InvokeAI
resources.description: Open-source creative engine with a unified canvas for image generation.
resources.why: A professional canvas for iterating on generated images.

resources.name: Piper TTS
resources.description: Fast local text-to-speech that runs on a Raspberry Pi.
resources.why: Offline voices for apps and home automation.

resources.name: faster-whisper
resources.description: Whisper reimplementation up to four times faster with less memory.
resources.why: Transcribe locally in a fraction of the time.

resources.name: whisper.cpp
resources.description: C/C++ port of Whisper that runs on CPU, even in the browser.
resources.why: Speech-to-text without Python or a GPU.

resources.name: screenshot-to-code
resources.description: Converts a screenshot or video of a UI into HTML, Tailwind, React or Vue code.
resources.why: The most direct open tool for the screenshot-to-first-draft step.

resources.name: Open Lovable
resources.description: Clones and recreates a website as a React app using AI and Firecrawl.
resources.why: Fast first draft of a site you own or may recreate.

resources.name: bolt.diy
resources.description: Open-source Bolt that lets you choose your own LLM provider.
resources.why: Build full-stack apps in the browser with any model.

resources.name: Dyad
resources.description: Local, open-source AI app builder that runs on your own machine.
resources.why: Lovable-style building without sending code to a hosted service.

resources.name: Onlook
resources.description: Visual editor for React and Tailwind apps with AI assistance.
resources.why: Edit a running app visually and have the code update.

resources.name: tldraw make-real
resources.description: Draw a UI on a canvas and have a vision model produce a working page.
resources.why: Sketch-to-prototype in a single step.

resources.name: Google Stitch
resources.description: Google Labs tool that generates UI designs and front-end code from prompts or images.
resources.why: Free design and code generation with export.

resources.description: Terminal AI pair programmer that edits your repo and commits for you.

resources.name: Cline

resources.why: Approve each file edit and command yourself.

resources.name: Roo Code
resources.description: VS Code agent with customisable modes for coding, architecture and debugging.
resources.why: Switch between specialised modes per task.

resources.name: Continue
resources.description: Open-source assistant for VS Code and JetBrains with your own models.
resources.why: Autocomplete and chat using whatever model you choose.

resources.name: Goose

resources.why: A general agent extensible through MCP servers.

resources.name: OpenHands
resources.description: Open-source agent platform that writes code, runs commands and browses.
resources.why: An autonomous developer you can self-host.

resources.name: Plandex
resources.description: Terminal agent built for large multi-file tasks with a diff review sandbox.
resources.why: Review the whole change before it touches your files.

resources.name: gpt-pilot

resources.name: Zed
resources.description: Very fast editor written in Rust with built-in AI and collaboration.
resources.why: Quick editor with optional AI features.

resources.name: OpenAI Codex CLI
resources.description: Open-source terminal coding agent from OpenAI.
resources.why: Run an agent against local files from the shell.

resources.name: Gemini CLI
resources.description: Open-source terminal agent with a free personal usage tier.
resources.why: Free agent in the terminal with a large context window.

resources.name: Qwen Code
resources.description: Command-line coding agent tuned for Qwen coder models.
resources.why: Pair an open coding model with a terminal workflow.

resources.name: OpenCode
resources.description: Terminal-based AI coding agent with a TUI that works with many providers.
resources.why: Provider-agnostic agent with a clean terminal UI.

resources.name: Repomix
resources.description: Packs your whole repository into one AI-friendly file.

resources.name: Gitingest

resources.why: Keeps long AI builds organised and resumable.

resources.name: BMAD-METHOD
resources.description: Agile-style framework with role-based AI agents for planning through delivery.
resources.why: Gives structure to large AI-assisted projects.

resources.name: awesome-cursorrules
resources.description: Collection of rules files for steering AI editors by framework.
resources.why: Starting points for project instructions that models follow.

resources.name: browser-use

resources.why: Automate multi-step web tasks with an agent.

resources.name: Open Interpreter

resources.why: Natural-language control of your machine.

resources.name: SWE-agent

resources.name: Langfuse
resources.description: Open-source tracing and analytics for LLM apps.
